bodies.name: Choir
bodies.class: gas giant with rings of almost pure lattice

lattice.where: The rings

bodies.notes: A gas giant whose rings are almost pure lattice, the purest large deposit known in the Basin. The local lane to it drifts so quickly that nobody has held a stable route for more than a few weeks.

bodies.name: Choir's rings
bodies.class: rings of nearly pure lattice

lattice.where: Nearly pure

bodies.name: Ring camp (WIP)
bodies.class: claim crews' camp
bodies.notes: Independent claim crews working the edge of the rings whenever they can find the lane.

bodies.name: Bellows
bodies.class: cold rocky world, breathable five months a year
bodies.notes: A cold rocky world whose Absent machinery floods its atmosphere with oxygen for five months of each year and leaves it unbreathable for the other seven. About four thousand settlers live in sealed towns, farming in the open season and mining shallow lattice the rest of the year. They pay the Seventh to keep Purview prospectors away.
bodies.gmNotes: Navy intelligence suspects the Seventh keeps its base somewhere near Bellows. It does: see the anchorage at Skerry.

bodies.name: The Seventh's anchorage (WIP)
bodies.class: hidden base
bodies.notes: Base of the Seventh: two frigates, a printer barge and about two thousand mutinous marines, with their tactical NHP ORDINAL.
bodies.gmNotes: The only way in runs one way from Gloam and the only way out runs to Halvard, so a pursuing fleet has to commit to a loop the Seventh has mapped better than anyone. Skerry lies a few hours from Bellows by a lane that drifts too fast for Navy charts.
